code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild renal impairment (elevated creatinine). There are also mild electrolyte disturbances (hyperchloremia), monocytosis, and basophilia. These findings may indicate bone marrow suppression or systemic illness with possible hypoxic and renal involvement. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
